snippet.title: Gameplay (no audio) Kitten Space Agency 2025.5.11.1304-LOCAL
snippet.description:
Gameplay video recorded from a Discord Developer Stage showcasing the current build of Kitten Space Agency on an AMD Ryzen 7800X3D / 4070 Ti. Fans in the Discord were asking questions and helping drive the content of the video but there is no audio recorded. The video does show movement around different celestial objects (Earth, Luna, Venus, Mars), some ISS viewpoint, and the test Rocket vehicle's orbital movement.

https://discord.gg/kittenspaceagency
